# Additional mascot renderer

`src/client/mascot.js` and `src/client/mascot-styles.js` were extracted from the Seal Harness capability-shared mascot renderer at source commit `fd7b6d82ef4ce6206f2a330a7ec4dc7409b254c6`.

The source repository uses the MIT license retained in this directory. These files render and animate the existing plugin avatar asset; the asset and robot avatar sources remain documented separately. No Seal authentication server, navigation implementation, credentials or private repository history is included.
